span.p:
Archive
2 crore row, kharcha
-> Postgres me har mahine ka alag tukda
purana DETACH -> S3 archive, jo kabhi nahi chahiye -> tukda DROP
(partition + archive)
1 saal purani khuli -> S3 se, dheemi par chalti
